items.text:
The fact that this game does not have a SAFETY LOCK KEY to PREVENT you from doing tasks that can get you kill due to misclicking/wrong selection ...

Caves of qud , Cataclysm dda both have it.
Go back to game making elementary school if u think your rooster permission is sufficient.
items.text_zh:
这款游戏居然没有安全锁键来防止你因为误点/选错而执行可能让你丧命的任务……

《Qud洞穴》和《大灾变DDA》都有。
如果你觉得你的公鸡权限就足够了，那就回游戏制作小学去吧。

observations.description: 缺少安全锁功能，误点或错误选择可能导致角色死亡
observations.evidence: this game does not have a SAFETY LOCK KEY to PREVENT you from doing tasks that can get you kill due to misclicking/wrong selection
observations.evidence_zh: 这个游戏没有安全锁定键来防止你因为误点/错误选择而执行可能让你丧命的任务

items.text:
Died because of missclicking outside of the ship while wearing no EVA suit
Died because floor patch broke and I had no pressure suit
Died because of getting shanked by two pirates who were sitting in 3x3 m room in the middle of space
Died three times because OKLG-Hauler pilots bought their driving license instead of taking flight lessons
Died because of internal bleeding because nanobots can't heal everything

Overall 11\10 will play again
items.text_zh:
因为没穿EVA宇航服时误点飞船外面而死
因为地板补丁破了而我没有压力服而死
因为被两个坐在太空中间3x3米房间里的海盗捅死
死了三次，因为OKLG-Hauler的飞行员买的是驾照而不是上的飞行课
因为内出血而死，因为纳米机器人不能治愈一切

总体 11\10 还会再玩
